title: OpenBrick3D part document (openbrick/part@1)
description: A parametric brick-compatible part (parts/*.obpart.json): typed parameters plus an ordered list of brick-aware feature operations. Read by openbrick-part as PartDoc; see docs/plan/06 sections 2 to 4. A 1.0 document may use only the top-level fields named here ($defs/knownFields), because serde would silently drop a misspelt one; params and features carry op-specific fields, so they stay open. Feature values may be literals with unit suffixes ("0.6mm", "2stud"), references ("$size") or small expressions ("profile.minFeature"), so op-specific fields are not typed here; the evaluator checks them. Semantic rules (unique feature ids, anchors defined before use) are checked by PartDoc::check.

kind.description: Optional; when present it must be part (docs/plan/08 section 1 gives every document a kind).

id.description: Reverse-DNS-ish, lower case: a namespace, a dot, then the part name, as in ndn.logo-tile (docs/plan/06 section 2).

version.description: Version of this part design; the schema version is the openbrick pragma.

params.description: Typed, UI-bearing parameters by name; features refer to them as $name.

presets.description: Named parameter sets, importable from OpenSCAD parameterSets JSON (docs/plan/06 section 3). Not read by openbrick-part yet.

features.description: Ordered feature operations; each may anchor on a face of an earlier one.

snap.description: derived (the default: connectors come from the features) or an explicit connector list for exotic parts (docs/plan/06 sections 2 and 6).

print.description: Print intent: which face is up per relief mode, allowed process profiles, fit-critical feature ids and extra rules. Free-form beyond these fields.

up.description: The face that faces up, either one face or one per relief mode.

profiles.description: Process profile ids this part is designed for.

fitCritical.description: Ids of fit-critical features; export needs a calibrated fit profile covering them (rule FIT.MISSING).

rules.description: Extra checks with an onFail action such as shrink-or-bolder.

export.description: Export formats and batch naming. Free-form beyond formats.

formats.description: File extensions to export, lower case (docs/plan/08).

lock.description: Reproducibility record: font hashes, process profile id, kernel version (docs/plan/06 section 10). Not read by openbrick-part yet.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.0 names, object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently, so a misspelt optional field would change nothing. Objects not listed here are open on purpose. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names this schema's minor version, 1.0 (or a 1.0.x patch). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9).

featureId.description: A feature id: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. No dots, because anchors are written id.face and PartDoc::check splits them at the first dot.

param.description: One parameter (openbrick_part::Param). Fields beyond those listed (maxLength, bundledOnly, onChange, ...) are kept by serde's flatten, so they are allowed.

default.description: Any JSON value matching the type.

min.description: A number, or a per-axis array for grid2.

max.description: A number, or a per-axis array for grid2.

options.description: Allowed values, either plain values or { value, label } pairs.

visibleWhen.description: Expression over other params, for example relief != 'inlay'.

feature.description: One feature operation (openbrick_part::Feature). Op-specific fields are kept by serde's flatten, so they are allowed; the evaluator reads them.

op.description: The operation. Must equal openbrick_part::KNOWN_OPS (a test in openbrick-part keeps the two in step).

on.description: Anchor: a face of an earlier feature, written id.face (for example body.top).

if.description: Expression; the feature is skipped when it is false.

colorRole.description: Colour role; one 3MF object per role (docs/plan/05 section 7).

offGrid.description: Decoration that emits no connectors (keychain loops and the like).

connector.description: An explicit connector for snap (docs/plan/06 section 6); positions are integer LDU.

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

semver.description: A Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version (pattern from semver.org).

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
